invariants.rationale: List#stream is called, which throws NullPointerException if data is null.
func is used as an argument in a method, so must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
The parameter is likely intended for degree of parallelism and negative/zero would not make sense for parallel execution.
A List's size is always non-negative by definition.
It is often best practice for parallelism to not exceed the data size to avoid wasted parallel resources.
